extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.DeleteRedisKey
extension.description: Deletes a key on the Dragonfly target for key_deleted/key_expired events from RedisKeyspaceEventConsumer, per spec section 4.4's relationship table.

relationship.name: success
relationship.description: Key deleted (or already absent) on the target

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.MigrationValidationProcessor
extension.description: Post-migration spot-check: samples keys from the source, compares them against the target, and emits a validation report FlowFile. Spec section 4.6.

property.name: sample-size
property.description: Number of keys to validate per trigger, taken from one SCAN page on the source (a spot-check sample, not a uniformly random sample of the full keyspace).

property.name: batch-size
property.description: Default number of FlowFiles of a given module-key category (json/topk/bloom-cms, see the per-category overrides below) to pipeline reads and writes for per trigger, instead of one blocking round trip per key - for any category without its own override. Also the combined cap across all such unoverridden categories together in one trigger, exactly as before this property split into per-category overrides existed.

property.name: batch-size-json
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for ReJSON-RL keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other category. Unset (the default) means these keys are governed by Batch Size like any other category without an override.

property.name: batch-size-topk
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for TopK (approximate-mode reconstruction) keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other category. Unset (the default) means these keys are governed by Batch Size like any other category without an override.

property.name: batch-size-bloom-cms
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for Bloom/Cuckoo Filter/CMS (--dfly-to-dfly DUMP/RESTORE-only keys) keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other category. Unset (the default) means these keys are governed by Batch Size like any other category without an override.

property.name: batch-timeout-ms
property.description: Max time to await pipeline completion for one batch's reads, or one batch's writes.

property.name: dfly-to-dfly
property.description: Enable when both source and target are Dragonfly. Uses DUMP/RESTORE - a byte-for-byte copy of the key's internal serialization - instead of type-specific read/reconstruct commands, for ReJSON-RL, TopK-TYPE, MBbloom-- (Bloom filter), MBbloomCF (Cuckoo Filter), and CMSk-TYPE (Count-Min Sketch) keys. Roughly halves round trips (one DUMP+RESTORE pair instead of a read command followed by a rebuild command) and, for TopK, is exact rather than the approximate TOPK.ADD-based reconstruction. Bloom, Cuckoo Filter, and CMS keys have no other reconstruction path in this processor, so they're only migrated when this is enabled; ReJSON-RL and TopK-TYPE fall back to their normal reconstruction for any key where DUMP or RESTORE itself fails. Only safe between Dragonfly instances on compatible versions - DUMP payloads aren't a portable format, and Cuckoo Filter support itself is version-gated on Dragonfly's side (e.g. present in df-v1.40.2, absent in df-v1.39.0).

relationship.name: failure
relationship.description: Unsupported module type or reconstruction failed

relationship.name: success
relationship.description: Module key reconstructed on the target

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.RedisBatchWriter
extension.description: Accepts FlowFiles from RedisTypeDeserializer/RedisSingleKeyFetch, batches them, and issues pipelined write commands to Dragonfly. Spec section 4.3.

property.name: batch-size
property.description: Default number of FlowFiles of a given Redis type to pipeline per trigger, for any type without its own override below. Also the combined cap across all such unoverridden types together in one trigger, exactly as before this property split into per-type overrides existed.

property.name: batch-size-string
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for string keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other type. Unset (the default) means string keys are governed by Batch Size like any other type without an override.

property.name: batch-size-hash
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for hash keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other type. Unset (the default) means hash keys are governed by Batch Size like any other type without an override.

property.name: batch-size-list
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for list keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other type. Unset (the default) means list keys are governed by Batch Size like any other type without an override.

property.name: batch-size-set
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for set keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other type. Unset (the default) means set keys are governed by Batch Size like any other type without an override.

property.name: batch-size-zset
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for sorted set (zset) keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other type. Unset (the default) means sorted set (zset) keys are governed by Batch Size like any other type without an override.

property.name: batch-size-stream
property.description: Overrides Batch Size for stream keys specifically - independent of, and in addition to, Batch Size's own combined cap on every other type. Unset (the default) means stream keys are governed by Batch Size like any other type without an override.

property.name: write-chunk-size
property.description: Max elements/fields/members sent to Dragonfly in a single RPUSH/SADD/ZADD/HSET call when writing one key. A key with more entries than this is written across several smaller commands instead of one command whose argument count scales with the key's own size (e.g. a multi-million-member set becoming one giant SADD).

property.name: batch-timeout-ms
property.description: Max time to await pipeline completion for one batch flush. 30s default accounts for large aggregate keys (e.g. multi-million-member sets/zsets) taking real time to transmit even when chunked/pipelined - a short timeout here just routes the write to retry while the original attempt keeps running in the background, risking overlapping writes to the same key.

property.name: max-pipeline-depth
property.description: Max outstanding key writes dispatched concurrently before awaiting completions.

property.name: write-confirmation
property.description: Await pipeline completion before committing the session. Disabling this means FlowFiles are routed to success without confirmation that Dragonfly accepted the write - the spec's own rationale (never fire-and-forget) argues against disabling it.

relationship.name: retry
relationship.description: Transient failure; route back to this processor's incoming queue

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.RedisDeadLetterWriter
extension.description: Terminal sink for failure relationships: writes FlowFile content and attributes to a JSON file, emits an ERROR bulletin, and increments the migration.failures.total counter. Spec section 8.2.

relationship.name: failure
relationship.description: Could not write the dead-letter file

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.RedisKeyspaceEventConsumer
extension.description: Subscribes to source Redis keyspace notifications, emitting one FlowFile per key change event for the live-phase replication pipeline. Spec section 4.4.

property.name: event-types
property.description: Comma-separated event types to include (e.g. set,del,expire,hset,lpush). Empty means all.

property.name: reconnect-backoff-ms
property.description: Lettuce auto-reconnects the underlying connection on its own; this value only throttles how often disconnect warnings are logged/bulletined.

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.RedisScanReader
extension.description: Scans the source Redis keyspace, partitioned across concurrent tasks by hash-slot range (cluster mode) or CRC16 modulo (standalone/sentinel), emitting one empty FlowFile per key with type/TTL metadata attributes. Routes by data type for downstream processing by RedisTypeDeserializer. Spec section 4.1.

property.name: migration-id
property.description: Unique identifier for this migration run, shared with the other migration processors, used to namespace cursor-checkpoint and partition-claim cache keys.

property.name: partition-count
property.description: Total number of partitions; must match this processor's Concurrent Tasks setting.

property.name: scan-count
property.description: COUNT hint per SCAN call.

property.name: key-pattern
property.description: SCAN MATCH pattern.

property.name: key-type-filter
property.description: Comma-separated list of types to include: string,hash,list,set,zset,stream.

property.name: prefix-deny-list
property.description: Comma-separated list of key prefixes to exclude from migration. A key is skipped if it starts with any of these prefixes. Leave unset to disable.

property.name: prefix-only-list
property.description: Comma-separated list of key prefixes to exclusively migrate. If set, a key is skipped unless it starts with one of these prefixes. Applied after Prefix Deny List. Leave unset to migrate all prefixes.

property.name: database-index-override
property.description: Override the connection pool's default database index. Standalone/sentinel only.

relationship.name: failure
relationship.description: SCAN or TYPE command failed for this key

relationship.name: unknown
relationship.description: Key type is unrecognised or a module type

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.RedisSingleKeyFetch
extension.description: Given a FlowFile with a redis.key attribute (from RedisKeyspaceEventConsumer), fetches the key's current value and serialises it identically to RedisTypeDeserializer. Spec section 4.5 - a thin TYPE-then-fetch wrapper reusing RedisValueFetcher's type dispatch.

property.name: hash-field-batch-size
property.description: Max fields per emitted FlowFile for a hash; larger hashes are split across multiple chunked FlowFiles that RedisBatchWriter re-assembles before writing.

property.name: stream-read-count
property.description: Max entries fetched per XRANGE call while paginating a stream's full history.

relationship.name: key_missing
relationship.description: Key expired between SCAN and fetch

relationship.name: module_type
relationship.description: Key is a module type (ReJSON-RL, TopK, etc.)

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.processors.RedisTypeDeserializer
extension.description: Reads the full value of a key emitted by RedisScanReader and writes it as a structured JSON payload into the FlowFile content, per spec section 4.2. Pipelines string/hash/list/set/zset reads across a batch of keys per trigger instead of one blocking round trip per key. Stream keys are still fetched one at a time.

property.name: hash-field-batch-size
property.description: Max fields per emitted FlowFile for a hash; larger hashes are split across multiple chunked FlowFiles that RedisBatchWriter re-assembles before writing.

property.name: stream-read-count
property.description: Max entries fetched per XRANGE call while paginating a stream's full history.

property.name: batch-size
property.description: Number of FlowFiles to pipeline reads for per trigger, instead of one blocking round trip per key. Applies to string/hash/list/set/zset keys - stream keys are always fetched one at a time (see the processor description).

property.name: batch-timeout-ms
property.description: Max time to await one batch's pipelined reads.

property.name: dfly-to-dfly
property.description: Enable when both source and target are Dragonfly. For string/hash/list/set/zset keys, reads via DUMP - a byte-for-byte copy of the key's internal serialization - instead of the type-specific GET/HGETALL/LRANGE/SMEMBERS/ZRANGE read, paired with RedisBatchWriter issuing a single RESTORE instead of a write command whose argument count scales with the key's own size (e.g. a multi-million-member zset becoming one 10,000,002-argument ZADD - RESTORE's argument count is fixed regardless of element count). Falls back to the normal per-type read for any key whose DUMP payload exceeds Max Dump Payload Bytes. Stream keys are unaffected - already written entry-by-entry, never had this problem. Only safe between Dragonfly instances on compatible versions - DUMP payloads aren't a portable format. Mirrors ModuleTypeHandler's own --dfly-to-dfly, which covers ReJSON-RL/TopK/Bloom/CMS keys separately.

property.name: max-dump-payload-bytes
property.description: Under Dragonfly-to-Dragonfly Optimizations, a key whose DUMP payload exceeds this many bytes falls back to the normal type-specific read instead - a defensive cap against the target's max-bulk-string-length limit (a different, much larger limit than the multibulk-element-count one DUMP/RESTORE itself avoids), independent of how many elements the key contains.

relationship.name: key_missing
relationship.description: Key expired between SCAN and fetch

relationship.name: module_type
relationship.description: Key is a module type (ReJSON-RL, TopK, etc.)

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.services.StandardDragonflyConnectionPoolService
extension.description: Provides a pooled connection to a target DragonflyDB instance for use by the migration write processors. Kept as a distinct controller service type from the source RedisConnectionPoolService so credentials and provenance are attributed independently, even though Dragonfly speaks the same protocol as Redis.

property.name: connection-mode
property.description: Redis topology mode. STANDALONE and SENTINEL both connect via a single Lettuce RedisClient (Lettuce auto-discovers the current master for a sentinel:// connection string); CLUSTER connects via RedisClusterClient against a comma-separated list of seed nodes.

property.name: connection-string
property.description: STANDALONE: redis://[:password@]host:port[/db] (or rediss:// for TLS). SENTINEL: redis-sentinel://[:password@]host1:port1,host2:port2/db#masterName. CLUSTER: comma-separated seed nodes, e.g. redis://host1:port1,redis://host2:port2.

property.name: require-tls
property.description: Whether connections must use TLS. Defaults to true; disabling requires explicit opt-in since unencrypted connections should never be used in production.

property.name: ssl-context-service
property.description: The SSLContextService used to configure TLS trust (and, optionally, a client keystore for mutual TLS). Required when Require TLS is true. Using NiFi's standard SSL Context Service keeps key material out of processor properties, flow.json.gz, and logs.

property.name: max-pool-size
property.description: Maximum number of pooled connections handed out concurrently per NiFi node.

property.name: database-index
property.description: SELECT index for STANDALONE/SENTINEL mode. Ignored for CLUSTER mode, which does not support multiple logical databases.

extension.name: io.dragonfly.nifi.redis.services.StandardRedisConnectionPoolService
extension.description: Provides a pooled connection to a source Redis-compatible datastore (Redis OSS, Redis Stack, Valkey, ElastiCache) for use by the migration scan and live-phase processors.

property.name: connection-mode
property.description: Redis topology mode. STANDALONE and SENTINEL both connect via a single Lettuce RedisClient (Lettuce auto-discovers the current master for a sentinel:// connection string); CLUSTER connects via RedisClusterClient against a comma-separated list of seed nodes.

property.name: connection-string
property.description: STANDALONE: redis://[:password@]host:port[/db] (or rediss:// for TLS). SENTINEL: redis-sentinel://[:password@]host1:port1,host2:port2/db#masterName. CLUSTER: comma-separated seed nodes, e.g. redis://host1:port1,redis://host2:port2.

property.name: require-tls
property.description: Whether connections must use TLS. Defaults to true; disabling requires explicit opt-in since unencrypted connections should never be used in production.

property.name: ssl-context-service
property.description: The SSLContextService used to configure TLS trust (and, optionally, a client keystore for mutual TLS). Required when Require TLS is true. Using NiFi's standard SSL Context Service keeps key material out of processor properties, flow.json.gz, and logs.

property.name: max-pool-size
property.description: Maximum number of pooled connections handed out concurrently per NiFi node.

property.name: database-index
property.description: SELECT index for STANDALONE/SENTINEL mode. Ignored for CLUSTER mode, which does not support multiple logical databases.
